simple: AI-powered next-generation antivirus in one lightweight agent managed from the cloud: installs in minutes without a reboot and needs no daily signature updates. Stops malware, ransomware and more sophisticated attacks, including fileless ones, on Windows, macOS and Linux computers and servers — online and offline. Controls the use of USB drives, SD cards and Thunderbolt devices. Also protects Android and iOS smartphones: spots malicious activity and keeps unauthorized users away from corporate data. Help with installation and setup — Express Support. Centrally manages the host firewall: policies are created and enforced from one console. Blocking combines machine learning, AI-powered indicators of attack (IOAs), exploit blocking and high-performance memory scanning. According to the bundle data sheet, an attack is shown as one process tree with context, detection details are kept for 90 days, and an affected computer can be contained and accessed remotely right away. Continuous event recording and attack detection (EDR), threat hunting, identity protection, IT hygiene and SIEM are not part of this bundle.
